## Introduction

This report shows the effect of temperature and population of origin on the growth rate of snails

## Results of Experiment

Below is the boxplot showing growth rates across temperature treatments of 10°C and 20°C and populations:


```{r boxplot-figure, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='70%'}
include_graphics("../results/MyBoxplot.pdf")
```

## Statistical Analysis

We did a two way ANOVA which evaluated temperature, population, and the interaction between the two:

```{r anova-summary, echo=FALSE}
m1.summary <- readRDS("../results/m1.summary.rds")
m1.summary
```

### Conclusion

Temperature and population both did not show statistically significant effect on snail growth rate. There was no significant effect between temperature and population.
